include_when: facility is explicitly mapped or named as warehouse, distribution center, fulfillment center, freight terminal, transload, cold storage, or logistics park inside a bounded A.3 target box
exclude_when: generic industrial building with no logistics role; self-storage; retail showroom; office park; contractor yard; residential moving/storage storefront; unclear business name
preferred_sources: OSM industrial/warehouse tags; public port or airport industrial maps; reviewed local economic-development or parcel sources
review_status_rule: packet_ready only when the facility role is explicit in tag, name, or public source; otherwise source_gated or exclude
claim_boundary: Industrial/logistics footprint only; not freight volume, employment, supply-chain importance, catchment, route choice, or demand.

include_when: facility is explicitly tied to port, marine terminal, container, rail-served warehouse, drayage, intermodal yard, cold-chain export/import, or port-adjacent industrial support
exclude_when: waterfront restaurant, marina, event venue, cruise/passenger-only context, generic waterfront commercial district, or port authority boundary without facility rows
preferred_sources: public port terminal pages; OSM landuse/industrial plus named terminal rows; local parcel/industrial district sources
review_status_rule: packet_ready only with named port-industrial function; boundary-only context remains anchor_context, not measured sidecar evidence
claim_boundary: Port-industrial support only; not port authority boundary, freight flow, vessel calls, container volume, employment, or trade area.

include_when: facility is explicitly mapped or named as air cargo, freight forwarder, cargo terminal, airport logistics, ground handling, or airport-edge distribution
exclude_when: passenger terminal, rental car center, hotel, parking, airline office, or generic airport-adjacent retail without cargo/logistics role
preferred_sources: airport cargo pages; OSM aeroway/cargo/logistics tags; public industrial district sources
review_status_rule: packet_ready only when cargo/logistics function is direct; airport proximity alone is not enough
claim_boundary: Airport cargo-support footprint only; not passenger flow, cargo tonnage, catchment, route choice, or airport service adequacy.

include_when: facility is explicitly mapped or named as intermodal yard, rail freight terminal, transload, rail-served warehouse, or depot-adjacent freight support
exclude_when: passenger station, transit center, rail museum, parking lot, office, or generic industrial row without freight/intermodal role
preferred_sources: rail operator terminal pages; OSM railway/freight tags; public industrial district sources
review_status_rule: packet_ready only when rail freight/intermodal role is explicit; passenger rail evidence belongs to transit_center/depot_intermodal
claim_boundary: Rail freight/intermodal footprint only; not train counts, freight volume, commuter catchment, or route choice.

include_when: facility is explicitly mapped or named as truck terminal, truck parking, truck stop, fleet yard, distribution center, freight carrier terminal, or travel center inside a highway/corridor target box
exclude_when: auto repair, car wash, dealership, gas station without truck/travel-center role, motel without freight role, AAA/travel agency naming false positives
preferred_sources: OSM truck_stop/transport/logistics tags; reviewed gas/convenience fixtures; brand/public facility pages
review_status_rule: packet_ready only when truck/freight role is explicit; ordinary car-trip services remain gas_convenience, auto_parts, or motel_lodging
claim_boundary: Highway freight-service footprint only; not freight flow, truck counts, route choice, trip purpose, or service adequacy.
